text_block_list.text: Yes... It's preparation for an upcoming event...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm memorizing the script so I won't make any mistakes, but there's just so much of it...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
But this is also an important chance to make an impression.
I have to do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Hokko Tarumae
wasn't able to get a good rest...
